name: Gradient Waves
description: An ethereal raymarched sine-plasma wave field with volumetric fog, film grain, and interactive pointer-driven camera parallax using WebGL and OGL.
author: React Bits

props.name: horizonColor
props.description: Distant haze color the waves fade into.

props.name: waveColor
props.description: Mid color of the rolling wave bodies.

props.name: crestColor
props.description: Highlight color of the nearest wave crests.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed of the undulating wave field.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: Height of the sine-plasma waves.

props.name: waveScale
props.description: Overall spatial frequency of the waves.

props.name: waveRatio
props.description: Ratio between the short and long wavelength components.

props.name: swell
props.description: Large-scale horizontal swell distortion.

props.name: turbulence
props.description: Large-scale cross-flow turbulence distortion.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Camera pitch toward the horizon (radians).

props.name: zoom
props.description: Field-of-view zoom into the wave field.

props.name: height
props.description: Vertical offset of the horizon line.

props.name: fogDepth
props.description: Distance over which the waves fade into haze and transparency.

props.name: detail
props.description: Raymarch quality tier: 'low', 'medium', or 'high'.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness multiplier for the final color.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Global opacity of the effect.

props.name: mouseInteraction
props.description: Enable subtle pointer-driven camera parallax.

props.name: parallaxStrength
props.description: Strength of the cursor parallax drift.

props.name: grain
props.description: Overlay a whisper-subtle animated film grain on the effect.

props.name: grainIntensity
props.description: Amplitude of the grain overlay. 0 disables it entirely.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the container.
